# thoth_agent_observe_summary (Data Source)

What enforcing would have held or denied for an agent in observe mode, and whether it is ready to enforce. Thoth only recommends: switch with thoth_agent_enforcement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thoth_agent_observe_summary" "billing" {
  agent_id = "billing-agent"
}

# Refuse the switch to enforce until Thoth says the agent is ready.
resource "thoth_agent_enforcement" "billing" {
  agent_id         = "billing-agent"
  enforcement_mode = "enforce"

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition = (data.thoth_agent_observe_summary.billing.ready_to_enforce ||
      data.thoth_agent_observe_summary.billing.mode == "enforce")
      error_message = data.thoth_agent_observe_summary.billing.next
    }
  }
}
```

`ready_to_enforce` is true only while the agent is in observe, so once it enforces, the
precondition holds on `mode`. Do not derive `enforcement_mode` from `ready_to_enforce`
itself: the next plan would switch the agent back to observe.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent ID.

### Optional

- `days` (Number) Days to summarise, 1 to 30 (default 7). Readiness always uses its own fixed windows.

### Read-Only

- `by_decision_json` (String) Counts by the decision enforcing would have made, as a JSON object (BLOCK means deny).
- `examples_json` (String) Recent actions enforcing would have changed, as a JSON array.
- `mode` (String) The agent's current mode: observe or enforce.
- `next` (String) What to do next, in words.
- `observed` (Number) Actions evaluated in observe mode in the window.
- `readiness_checks_json` (String) Each readiness check as a JSON array of {id, passed, detail}.
- `ready_to_enforce` (Boolean) True when the agent is in observe and passes every check: at least 7 days observed, at least 50 actions in the last 7 days, at most 2% that would have been held or denied, and nothing that would have been denied in the last 3 days.
- `top_rules_json` (String) The rules behind most would-change decisions, as a JSON array of {key, count}.
- `would_change` (Number) Of those, the actions enforcing would have held or denied.
